name: Quartzsite
note: Winter RV town. Dump and water are seasonal — confirm hours.

name: Yuma
note: Full resupply south of the Imperial Dam LTVA.

name: Blythe
note: I-10 services for Midland and Mule Mountain.

name: Needles
note: Colorado River town. Confirm the public dump.

name: Parker
note: Colorado River town west of Quartzsite. Confirm the dump and propane.

name: Ehrenberg
note: Truck-stop propane on the river.

name: El Centro
note: Resupply for Hot Springs, Tamarisk, and Pilot Knob. BLM field office is in town.

name: Bishop
note: Owens Valley grocery and dump between the Sierra and the White Mountains.

name: Barstow
note: I-15 hub for Owl Canyon and Afton Canyon.

name: Ridgecrest
note: Nearest town to Trona Pinnacles. Confirm the dump before you count on it.

name: Las Vegas
note: Full services. Red Rock is a scenic drive with a fee, not a yard for the trailer.

name: Pahrump
note: West of Las Vegas. Confirm a public dump.

name: Tonopah
note: Small highway town. Grocery is real. Dump and propane need a confirmation.

name: Kingman
note: I-40 hub for Craggy Wash and Burro Creek.

name: Moab
note: Busy in spring and fall. BLM camping near town has designated zones and fees in places.

name: St. George
note: Full services. Zion is a national park, not a free overnight.

name: Grand Junction
note: Hub for 18 Road and Rabbit Valley.

name: Bend
note: Summer hub. Deschutes forest roads are an MVUM product.

name: Burns
note: Town for Steens and the Alvord. Confirm dump and propane.

name: Kamloops
note: Interior B.C. resupply. Crown land nearby is 14 days and not a blob on this map.

name: Prince George
note: Northern B.C. grocery town. Confirm the sani-dump.

name: Cranbrook
note: East Kootenay hub. Provincial parks nearby charge fees.

name: Thunder Bay
note: Non-residents need an Ontario Crown land camping permit. Sleeping Giant is a provincial park, not free Crown land.

name: Whitehorse
note: Territorial capital. Highway campgrounds are paid. Territorial land outside town is not a reserved site.
